items.claim: Crews began covering the temporary steel roof over the Hagia Sophia dome in July 2026, to protect the structure, its mosaics and the workers.
items.quote: begin covering the temporary steel roof built to protect the historic structure

items.claim: The mosque stays open to worshippers and visitors while the restoration goes on.
items.quote: Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque will remain open to worshippers and visitors throughout the restoration process.

items.claim: A steel platform is being installed inside the eastern half-dome for structural reinforcement and conservation work.
items.quote: a steel platform to be installed inside the eastern half-dome for structural reinforcement and conservation work.

items.claim: The outside of the main dome is now completely covered, and the work continues on the eastern semi-dome.
items.quote: The exterior of the main dome has been completely covered.
